programmes.d: Løjtnant Tasha Yar bliver kidnappet af ligoniere og må kæmpe for sin frihed og en sygdomsramt planet i Føderationen.

Teenageren Wesley Crusher og et døende rumvæsen er besætningens eneste håb om at undslippe en bizar galakse, hvor tanker bliver til virkelighed.

programmes.t: Star Trek: Voyager: Igen Og Igen
programmes.d: When Paris and Janeway are sent back in time, they must decide whether to violate the Prime Directive by warning residents of a planet facing annihilation.
Neelix faces certain death when an alien race stricken by a devastating plague "harvests" his lungs.
The crew discovers that a nebula is not what it seems, and Paris invites his fellow officers to share a little "R&R" in his holodeck program.
Host Matt Mira and guests Jayne Brook, Doug Jones and Ted Sullivan discuss "Si Vis Pacem, Para Bellum".

programmes.t: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Kamplinjer

programmes.t: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Historiefortælleren
programmes.d: Against his will, O'Brien becomes spiritual leader of a Bajoran village--and the only one who can save them from a destructive energy force.

programmes.t: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Fremskridt
programmes.d: A stubborn old Bajoran farmer forces Kira to take a good look at how much she has changed since her alliance with the Federation.

Archer, Trip and T'Pol make first contact with the suspicious and militaristic Andorians while helping to reveal the secrets within the ancient Vulcan monastery of P'Jem, uncovering a major violation of the Andorian/Vulcan Peace Treaty
Archer attempts a little diplomacy with a very unwelcoming Vulcan Captain. Reed and Mayweather are in danger while drilling for samples on an uncharted massive comet.
Discovering their first alien civilization, Archer and the crew unfortunately also find a ship of invasive alien miners who are carelessly causing thousands of innocent deaths upon the planet.

programmes.d: Odo is caught in the middle when an alien influence pits Kira against Sisko in a deadly power struggle.

When a lightning storm in space scares a young Michael Burnham, her father aims to ease her fears with a mythical story about a brave little girl who faced her own fears head on.

12-year-old classmates Kima and Lil find themselves at odds with each other on a day that will change their lives forever.
An alien leader has the technology that could send the crew 40,000 light years closer to home -- but refuses to share it with them.
